description: You are a mystery shopper who visited Riverside Diner yesterday. Complete the evaluation report spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/mystery_shop_riverside_diner.xlsx. Enter the scores from your handwritten notes (shown at the bottom of the sheet) into column B. Create AVERAGE formulas for each section (B11, B20, B28, B35, B41). Create a weighted average formula in B44 using the specified weights (Greeting 15%, Service 35%, Food 25%, Cleanliness 15%, Payment 10%). Calculate the percentage score in B45 (Overall/5*100). Create an IF formula in B46 that displays 'YES' if percentage >= 85, otherwise 'NO'. Save the file (Ctrl+S).
